choices: HashSet does not support custom types
hashCode() is not overridden — points with equal fields land in different buckets
explanation: HashSet first compares hashCode() to find the bucket, then uses equals(). Without overriding hashCode(), two Point(1,2) objects have different hashes and are stored in different buckets — contains() returns false even though equals() would return true. Always override hashCode() when you override equals().
